title: Resources and the store
summary: Seven resources, stores and cargo limits.
bodyHtml:
Seven resources: rations, torches, ammo, medicine (physic), spares, veils, rockets. Each drains on its own clock.

  • The Cinder Ford Emporium sells with 600 scrip and a hard cargo cap. Rations for the whole trip alone would cost more than you have.
  • Anything found must fit in the wagons or be left behind.
  • Stopping to shop at a store costs hours.
  • The Meridian Wayhouse commissary short-weights rations and physic by a fifth unless you spend an hour checking the scales; a fair tell is in the shop text.
  • Last Lamp is the last store, with brutal prices.
  • Torches are both light and defense: the camp ring is the nightly cost, and torches are strong against the Hollowed and beasts in combat.
  • Spares repair wagons; a mechanic halves repair time.
  • Maps are also bought at the start store or outposts. See Route map, forks and misleading maps.

Files: src/game/world.ts (stores), types.ts (resource ids), tuning.ts, night.ts.
